Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 06-Feb-2025 (01:00 PM - 04:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  FIRST SEMESTER B.TECH. (CORE STREAM) EXAMINATION - FEBRUARY 2025  
  SUBJECT: MIE_1071 - BASIC MECHANICAL ENGINEERING  
  (MAKEUP)  
  Basic Mechanical Engineering [MIE-1071]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                       Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  a  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1A)               A steam boiler provides steam at the rate of 150kg/min at 2 bar and 200°C using feed water at       (4)  
  30°C. The fuel has a calorific value of 40MJ/kg. The fuel consumption is found to be at the rate of  
  15kg/min in the presence of economizer. The economizer preheats the feed water to a temperature  
  of 80°C. What will be the boiler efficiency? In case, the feed water is at 20°C which is raised to  
  60°C after preheating in economizer, what will be the boiler efficiency assuming all other  
  parameters remains the same as earlier? Assume the specific heat of water as 4.187 kJ/kgK and  
  that of superheated steam as 2.25 kJ/kgK.  
1B)               Dry steam at 118.6°C is passed through a pipeline which is connected to a chamber where the        (3)  
  steam loses 100kJ/kg of enthalpy. Consequently, the steam is passed through another chamber  
  where the steam is heated by 500kJ/kg. What is the condition of steam and the related parameter at  
  the exit of each chamber? Assume the specific heat of water as 4.187 kJ/kgK and that of  
  superheated steam as 2.25 kJ/kgK.  
1C)               Explain in detail any three limitations of fire tube boiler.                                             (3)  
2A)               The belt drive has a centre distance of 1m and provides a velocity ratio of 2. If the coefficient of (4)  
  friction between the belt and pulley=0.3, diameter of driven pulley=0.1m, tight side tension=4000N,  
  slack side tension=2000N, driver shaft speed=200rpm, find the type of belt drive used. Also find the  
  driven pulley speed and belt length.  
2B)               Gear A, B, C, D, E, F and G has 20, 30 ,40, 50, 60, 100 and 80 teeth respectively and are used in a (3)  
  gear train. The module of gear A, B, C are 4 while the rest of the gears have a module equal to 2.  
  Determine the minimum possible velocity ratio that can be achieved using 3 shafts. What will be the  
  minimum possible velocity ratio if maximum number of gears are to be used without the restriction  
  on the number of shafts. Draw the gear arrangement for each case.  
2C)               Explain any three limitations and advantages of gear train.                                              (3)  
3A)               An engine has a cam shaft speed of 1000 rpm and consumes 0.01kg/s of fuel. The brake load is             (4)  
  40kg and the brake drum diameter is 0.1m. The Mean effective pressure is 4 bar and has a  
  compression ratio of 10. If the stroke length-to-bore ratio is 1.5 and indicated thermal efficiency is  
  30%, find the stroke length and bore. Also find the BP and clearance volume of the cylinder. The  
  calorific value of fuel is 25MJ/kg  
3B)               Explain the operation of 4 stroke petrol engine with neat sketches.                                      (3)  
3C)               Explain any three advantages of 2 stroke engine.                                                         (3)  
4A)               With neat sketches, explain how the internal threading operation and hole size enlargement               (4)  
  operation is carried out using drilling machine.  
4B)               Explain in detail the usefulness of feed rod and lead screw in lathe machine.                            (3)  
4C)               Explain any three features of CNC machine which makes it better than NC machine.                         (3)  
  
  Page #1

5A)   Explain any four sand casting defects.                          (4)  
5B)   Make a comparison of gas welding and resistance spot welding.   (3)  
5C)   Explain three improvements needed for CNC machine.              (3)
